evidence_chain: Fact: The 2025 Form 20-F states that ARCO's digital channels, including mobile app, delivery, self-order kiosks and order ahead, represented 61% of systemwide sales, or $3.7 billion in digital sales. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1508478/000162828026028950/arco-20251231.htm

Fact: The 2025 Form 20-F states that McCafé locations generally provide a higher profit margin than regular restaurant operations. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1508478/000162828026028950/arco-20251231.htm

Fact: The company reported that Q4 2025 digital channel sales rose 18.7% and represented 62% of fourth-quarter systemwide sales. Source: https://www.advfn.com/stock-market/NYSE/ARCO/stock-news/98096025/arcos-dorados-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year

Fact: The company reported Q1 2026 total revenues of about $1.2 billion, up 12.9% in U.S. dollars year over year, and digital channel sales at 64% of systemwide sales. Source: https://www.fidelity.com/news/article/default/202605200715BIZWIRE_USPR_____20260520_BW704665

Fact: Current market data as of the latest available tool snapshot shows ARCO market capitalization of approximately $1.86 billion, placing it in the mid-cap bucket. Source: web finance snapshot, latest trade time June 12, 2026 23:15 UTC.

Inference: Because digital already represents a majority of systemwide sales, the next research edge is not simply whether digital adoption continues, but whether incremental digital mix improves restaurant-level economics after delivery fees, app incentives, labor scheduling, kiosk capex and payment costs.

Inference: McCafé may be an underappreciated margin lever if it increases daypart utilization and mix without proportionate labor and occupancy cost increases; this must be verified through segment or management disclosure because the annual-report statement is qualitative, not a quantified margin bridge.
Hypothesis: U.S.-focused restaurant investors may discount ARCO because reported U.S.-dollar earnings can look noisy even when local-currency demand is durable.
falsification_plan: If digital penetration continues rising but restaurant-level margin, adjusted EBITDA margin or free cash flow do not improve over multiple quarters, downgrade the operating-efficiency thesis.
If comparable-sales growth is in line with or below blended inflation and traffic is flat or declining, treat reported growth as low-quality inflation pass-through.
If food-and-paper, payroll, occupancy and royalty costs as percentages of sales rise faster than revenue leverage, reject the margin-expansion leg of the thesis.
If local-currency growth repeatedly fails to translate into U.S.-dollar EBITDA or distributable cash flow because of FX depreciation, downgrade the public-market vehicle quality.
If required remodels, openings or franchise obligations cause capex to exceed sustainable operating cash flow, downgrade the cash-return thesis.
If McDonald's master-franchise economics become more onerous, or if development commitments accelerate without adequate returns, reassess the risk/reward of ARCO as a regional chokepoint.
If delivery and app growth are driven by discounting rather than frequency, loyalty retention or mix improvement, reject the digital-conversion thesis.
deep_reports.hidden_signal_to_verify: CN: 隐藏信号是数字销售占比和忠诚度用户增长是否真正降低服务成本、提高订单频次、改善客单价和餐厅层面利润率，而不是仅仅把线下订单迁移到线上；同时要验证本币增长能否穿透汇率折算，形成美元口径 EBITDA 和自由现金流。EN: The hidden signal is whether digital sales mix and loyalty growth actually reduce service cost, lift frequency, improve ticket size and expand restaurant-level margin, rather than merely shifting offline orders online. A second signal is whether local-currency growth survives FX translation into U.S.-dollar EBITDA and free cash flow.
next_research_tasks: Pull the full 2025 Form 20-F and build a three-year bridge for revenue, systemwide comparable sales, adjusted EBITDA, net income, operating cash flow, capex and free cash flow.
Separate reported U.S.-dollar growth from constant-currency growth by Brazil, NOLAD, SLAD and Caribbean divisions.
Quantify company-operated restaurant cost structure: food and paper, payroll, occupancy, royalty fees and G&A as percentages of company-operated restaurant sales.
Extract unit count, net openings, EOTF/remodeled restaurants, franchised versus company-operated mix, and capex per new/remodeled unit.
Create a digital economics checklist: digital sales mix, mobile app users, loyalty members, delivery mix, self-order kiosk penetration, order frequency, average ticket and promotion intensity.
Compare ARCO margin trajectory against McDonald's corporate franchise model and against Latin American QSR peers where available, while avoiding simplistic comparisons to U.S.-only restaurants.
Review the master franchise agreement renewal terms, royalty schedule, development commitments, remodel obligations and termination provisions.
Build an FX sensitivity table for Brazil, Argentina, Mexico and other major operating currencies against U.S.-dollar EBITDA and free cash flow.
Track whether McCafé expansion is disclosed with unit count, sales mix or margin contribution; upgrade only if qualitative higher-margin language is supported by quantified contribution.
Monitor Q2 2026 and later filings for whether the Q1 2026 digital mix of 64% is sustained and whether it coincides with margin improvement.
risks: CN: 汇率风险：巴西雷亚尔、阿根廷比索、墨西哥比索及其他经营货币贬值可能把本币增长转化为较弱的美元收入、EBITDA 和现金流。EN: FX risk: depreciation in the Brazilian real, Argentine peso, Mexican peso and other operating currencies can turn local-currency growth into weaker U.S.-dollar revenue, EBITDA and cash flow.

CN: 通胀与成本风险：食品纸品、工资、租金、能源、物流和特许权使用费可能抵消同店销售和数字化带来的经营杠杆。EN: Inflation and cost risk: food and paper, payroll, occupancy, energy, logistics and royalties may offset operating leverage from comparable sales and digital adoption.
CN: 需求质量风险：同店销售增长可能主要来自涨价和通胀，而非真实客流或频次提升。EN: Demand-quality risk: comparable-sales growth may come mainly from pricing and inflation rather than traffic or frequency.

CN: 数字化误判风险：数字订单、外卖和自助点餐可能提高便利性，但若促销、平台费用、配送成本或技术投入过高，未必提升利润率。EN: Digital-misread risk: digital ordering, delivery and kiosks may improve convenience, but may not expand margins if promotions, platform fees, delivery costs or technology investments are too high.

CN: 主加盟协议风险：开发承诺、翻新义务、特许权使用费安排或与 McDonald's 的协议条款可能限制自由现金流弹性。EN: Master-franchise risk: development commitments, remodel obligations, royalty terms and agreement provisions with McDonald's may limit free-cash-flow flexibility.
CN: 国家和监管风险：拉美多国经营带来资本管制、税务、劳工、食品安全、进口和政治风险。EN: Country and regulatory risk: multi-country Latin American operations create capital-control, tax, labor, food-safety, import and political risks.

CN: 杠杆和资本开支风险：新店、EOTF 门店、翻新和数字基础设施投入若超过经营现金流改善，可能压低自由现金流。EN: Leverage and capex risk: new units, EOTF stores, remodels and digital infrastructure can pressure free cash flow if investment exceeds operating-cash-flow improvement.
deep_reports.supply_chain_position: CN: 产业链位置：全球 QSR 品牌 IP 与菜单体系 McDonald's → 拉美区域主加盟商 Arcos Dorados → 公司直营及特许经营门店 → 数字渠道，包括移动 App、外卖、自助点餐机、提前点单 → 本地食品与纸品供应商、物流、门店租赁、劳动力、支付和营销系统 → 终端消费者。ARCO 处在品牌资产下游、消费者需求上游、门店运营与区域执行的中间节点。其卡点更像“区域运营效率 + 数字转化 + 汇率折算”卡点，而不是传统餐饮品牌发现。EN: Supply-chain position: global QSR brand IP and menu system McDonald's → Latin American master franchisee Arcos Dorados → company-operated and franchised restaurants → digital channels including mobile app, delivery, self-order kiosks and order ahead → local food and paper suppliers, logistics, real estate, labor, payments and marketing systems → consumers. ARCO sits between brand IP and local consumer demand, acting as a regional execution node. The chokepoint is regional operating efficiency, digital conversion and FX translation rather than simple restaurant-brand discovery.
deep_reports.thesis_cn: 推论：ARCO 是麦当劳在拉美的相对纯粹公开载体，真正卡点不是消费者是否知道麦当劳，而是公司能否在拉美复杂宏观、汇率、通胀和主加盟协议约束下，把数字化订单、外卖、自助点餐、McCafé、门店翻新和新店扩张转化为美元口径的餐厅利润率、调整后 EBITDA 和自由现金流。若数字渗透率提高但餐厅层面利润率没有改善，或同店销售主要由通胀涨价而非客流驱动，该 thesis 应被降级。
deep_reports.thesis_en: Inference: ARCO is a relatively pure public-market vehicle for McDonald's Latin America growth. The chokepoint is not consumer awareness of McDonald's; it is whether ARCO can convert digital ordering, delivery, self-order kiosks, McCafé, remodels and unit openings into U.S.-dollar restaurant margins, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow despite Latin American macro, FX, inflation and master-franchise constraints. If digital penetration rises without restaurant-level margin improvement, or if comparable sales are driven mostly by inflationary pricing rather than traffic, the thesis should be downgraded.

deep_reports.title_en: Arcos Dorados: An Underfollowed Operating-Efficiency Chokepoint for McDonald's Latin America
deep_reports.why_underfollowed: CN: ARCO 容易被美国餐饮筛选漏掉，因为它不是美国本土餐饮品牌，而是麦当劳拉美主加盟商；财务信号被巴西、阿根廷、墨西哥等国家组合、汇率折算、通胀、特许权使用费、翻新义务和主加盟协议复杂性掩盖。EN: ARCO may be missed by U.S.-centric restaurant screens because it is not a domestic U.S. restaurant brand but the Latin American McDonald's master franchisee. The operating signal is obscured by country mix, FX translation, inflation, royalties, remodel obligations and master-franchise agreement complexity.

summary: CN: 本层对餐饮主题中的一个低关注度深挖标的 Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc. 进行 Layer 5 迷你深度报告。结论性质为研究假设/推论，不是交易建议。ARCO 的核心不是麦当劳品牌认知，而是拉美主加盟商能否把数字化、外卖、自助点餐、翻新和开店转化为美元口径的利润与自由现金流。EN: This Layer 5 report examines Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc. as an underfollowed restaurants-theme target. The conclusion is a research inference/hypothesis, not a trading recommendation. The key issue is not McDonald's brand awareness, but whether the Latin American master franchisee can convert digital ordering, delivery, self-order kiosks, remodels and new units into U.S.-dollar earnings and free cash flow.
